name: Isabel the Witch
original_name: イザベル・ザ・ウィッチ
source:
A "witch" who teams with Sandy as witch hunters. Wicked, seductive, and hedonistic, Isabel is a nymphomaniac who loves having sex more than anything.

Her signature weapon is a flail (chain morning star).

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://clockup.net/maggotbaits/character2.html]official website[/url]]
